title: Cross-machine browser automation
description: Running scripts in an extension-isolated browser task space on a paired computer (#12866): browser.machines and browser.run require browser.run in permissions.hub (named grant only). Backed by a pluggable BrowserBackend interface (defaulting to ego lite; extensible to CDP and other browser drivers). Params are strict: an unknown field is invalid_params. Plugin-side: only the hub and the program speak it.

BrowserMachinesParams.description: browser.machines (browser.run): list computers that have a browser backend enabled.

backend.description: Optional backend filter (e.g. ego, cdp). Empty returns all backends.

BrowserRunParams.description: browser.run (browser.run): run a script inside an extension-isolated browser task space on machine_id.

slot.description: Logical slot name scoped to this extension (e.g. pac-muse).

script.description: Async JS script body executed inside the isolated task space.

output.description: Raw output / JSON payload returned by the browser backend.
